routes.summary: /dashboard/creator renders the Creator Dashboard landing route, not the operations settings hub.
/dashboard/creator/settings renders CreatorDashboardSettingsHub as the creator operations workspace.
Creator dashboard, creator settings, drop manage, user settings, and profile route constants are explicit.

navigationFindings.summary: The landing dashboard Creator settings pill links to the creator settings workspace.
The landing dashboard Manage drops CTA points to the creator drop submission manager.
Sidebar keeps Creator Dashboard for the landing route and adds Creator Settings for operations.
Profile dropdown keeps separate creator landing and creator settings destinations.
Account settings links use Account Settings, not ambiguous Settings, while creator operations use Creator Settings.
User settings stays account-only and routes creator operations to Creator Settings.
Legacy creator settings notice points to Creator Settings, not the dashboard landing route.

mobileFindings.summary: Creator Dashboard landing uses one compact Creator Overview module and bottom-nav-safe spacing.
Creator Settings workspace keeps compact mobile density and safe bottom spacing.

errorFindings.summary: Creator settings load failures use HumanErrorNotice instead of concatenating raw module errors.
